title: [ingest] autodoc sets sys.modules reset guard: module partially in sys.modules on failure
summary: If importing a module with `TYPE_CHECKING=True` fails, the partially-registered submodules remain in `sys.modules`. `autodoc: Reset sys.modules on partial import failure (#11645)` addressed this by clearing the partial entries, but only when `SPHINX_AUTODOC_RELOAD_MODULES=1` is set. Without the env var, stale partial imports may cause confusing autodoc errors on subsequent builds.
